company.description:
A smart way to get a visa card within minutes. With Uni, pay flexibly in 3 parts over 3 months for no extra costs. Apply now and get the digital card on the Uni app. We’re currently lifetime free for early users. 


Uni Cards was established on October, 2020 by Nitin Gupta in Bangalore, Karnataka.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Debt Financing round raised $6,432,858, or 6.78% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $82,259,000 to $350,000,000, a 4.25x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
